# WAITING FOR:
#   1. TXSQL source → build TXSQL → produce RPMs
#   2. Run: readelf -d /path/to/mysqld | grep NEEDED
#   3. Run: ldd /path/to/mysqld
#   4. Run: rpm -qpR txsql-server-*.rpm
#   5. Run: repoquery --requires --resolve --recursive txsql-server
#   6. Run: strace -f mysqld --initialize-insecure 2>&1 | grep '\.so'
#   7. Run: cat /proc/$(pgrep mysqld)/maps | grep '\.so'
#
# Until all 7 steps complete on a real CentOS 7.9 system,
# we cannot guarantee this file is empty.

# =============================================================================
# KNOWN UNKNOWNS (will be resolved at build time)
# =============================================================================

# 1. TXSQL-specific plugin dependencies
#    Some TXSQL plugins may dynamically link to libraries not in the
#    standard MySQL 8.0 set. Examples:
#    - ColumnStore engine → protobuf, Apache Arrow, Apache Parquet?
#    - Thread pool plugin → additional libaio symbols?
#    - Tencentsm plugin → Tencent-specific crypto library?
#    Resolution: Run inspect-elf.sh on ALL plugin .so files.

# 2. OpenSSL version dependency
#    Depends on cmake option: -DWITH_SSL=system | bundled | /path
#    - system: Need openssl-libs 1.1.1+ (CentOS 7 only has 1.0.2k)
#    - bundled: MySQL bundles 1.1.1, no RPM dep on openssl-libs
#    - /path: Links to specified build, must bundle matching .so
#    Resolution: Confirmed -DWITH_SSL=bundled is the right choice for CentOS 7.

# 3. libstdc++ ABI version
#    devtoolset-8 (GCC 8.3.1) generates code that may require:
#    - CXXABI_1.3.9 symbols (not in CentOS 7 system libstdc++)
#    - GLIBCXX_3.4.25 symbols (not in CentOS 7 system libstdc++)
#    Resolution: Static-link libstdc++ and libgcc_s. Verified by:
#      readelf -d mysqld | grep NEEDED  → should NOT show libstdc++.so.6

# 4. libjemalloc version and licensing
#    MySQL bundles jemalloc. Check:
#    - Which version is bundled?
#    - Is it statically or dynamically linked?
#    - License compatibility (jemalloc is BSD — compatible)
#    Resolution: Audit extra/jemalloc/ in TXSQL source.

# 5. iconv / character set dependencies
#    MySQL uses GNU libiconv for character set conversion.
#    On CentOS 7, this is part of glibc (libc.so.6 provides iconv).
#    No separate RPM needed. Verified on ISO.

# 6. Timezone data
#    MySQL needs timezone information. Options:
#    - tzdata RPM (part of minimal install)
#    - MySQL internal timezone tables (mysql_tzinfo_to_sql)
#    Resolution: tzdata is in @core group. No extra RPM needed.

# =============================================================================
# CURRENT STATUS: CANNOT MARK AS RESOLVED
# =============================================================================

# we don't know. Every entry here is a concrete verification task.

# collect-dependencies.sh) is designed to auto-detect and auto-resolve
# these unknowns. Once TXSQL is built, running the pipeline will confirm
# whether unresolved.txt is truly empty.
